name: rush-sr-maintenance
description: Rush SR maintenance answers from the owner's manual: diagnose a symptom, find a service interval, get the steps for a procedure.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about your Rush SR and get answers from the public Rush SR owner's manual, each with a link to the exact section.

Diagnose a symptom, such as a car that will not start or paddles that do nothing. Look up the service interval for a component and which interval it belongs to (every session, weekend, month, year or 150+ hours). Get the steps for a procedure, such as bleeding the brakes or changing the differential oil.

It searches the manual and returns the matching excerpts. It does not call a language model, stores nothing and needs no sign-in. It covers the Rush SR only.

Built by RUSH Auto Works Inc.
defaultPrompt: Why won't my Rush SR start? The dash shows N.
How often should I change the brake fluid on my Rush SR?
How do I bleed the brakes on my Rush SR?
